title: Counterfactual simulated rollback orchestrator with fidelity limiter and synthetic-attenuation
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: avoid noisy or overly-conservative automated rollbacks in staged model rollouts by running a counterfactual simulation that replays sampled live traffic against candidate model variants before committing promotion decisions. This PR introduces a counterfactual rollback orchestrator that: 1) performs a low-latency counterfactual replay of representative request samples through candidate variants, 2) computes distributional deltas for configured SLO and quality signals (latency P95, token cost, token entropy, rerank precision), 3) applies a fidelity-limiter that gates promotions based on the effective sample fidelity (synthetic vs real ratio) and cohort variance, and 4) integrates an attenuation policy that reduces traffic fraction gradually with backoff/quarantine semantics when simulated deltas exceed thresholds. High level: introduces a simulation harness and a runtime hook into the rollout controller so that automated promote/rollback decisions are informed by simulated outcome projections rather than only by live SLO windows. This reduces flapping and gives ops a deterministic dry-run artifact to inspect before automated actions. Notable behaviors: - By default the orchestrator runs in "dry-evaluate" mode for new models: it computes projected deltas but does not change traffic until the fidelity-limiter is satisfied or a human-approved override is present. - When fidelity-limiter is triggered the system can either: a) delay promotion and expand sampling, b) perform a staged attenuation (reduce traffic fraction with time-based backoff), or c) quarantine the candidate and emit an audit-runbook entry. - The simulation reuses existing prefix-KV cache snapshots to realistically approximate inference path performance and samples KV cache warmup ratios from live cohort traces. Implementation notes: the runtime hook is implemented in rollout/controller/orchestrator.go and calls into rollout/simulator/counterfactual_sim.go which exposes a compact API: SimulateCandidate(ctx, candidateSpec, sampleBatch, simulationConfig) -> SimulationReport. The fidelity limiter config is feature-flagged and controlled via charts/values/feature-flags.yaml; console docs and a step-by-step runbook are added at console/docs/rollback-workflow.md. Testing: included integration harness tests that run local replay against synthetic traces and a small-scale e2e against the dev Dedicated stack. Backwards compatibility: run in opt-in mode until the feature flag is promoted cluster-wide. Related: ENG-1402 (simulation framework), ENG-1407 (telemetry aggregation), SUP-881 (customer incident that motivated counterfactual replays). Checklist: - [x] implement simulation harness and API - [x] integrate with rollout controller hooks - [x] implement fidelity limiter and attenuation/quarantine policies - [x] add unit + integration tests - [x] update console docs and runbook - [x] feature-flag the rollout behavior - [x] load-test at dev Dedicated scale Summary of risk/mitigations: simulation operates on sampled traffic and is intentionally conservative (requires configurable fidelity threshold). Any automated traffic reduction uses exponential backoff with operator notification and easy manual override. Merge strategy: squash and include the simulation report schema in the merge commit for traceability.

release_notes: Added an opt-in counterfactual simulation that evaluates candidate model promotions before automated commits. New fidelity-limiter and attenuation policy reduce flapping and provide safer automated rollouts. Admins can enable via feature-flag in charts/values/feature-flags.yaml. Included runbook at ops/runbooks/counterfactual-playbook.md.
notes_for_ops: Feature is gated behind feature flag 'counterfactual_rollback'. To enable cluster-wide: 1) set flag in charts to 'enabled: true' for rollout-controller, 2) ensure sim-worker pool has capacity label 'sim=true' on at least 3 nodes, 3) validate simulation reports in console before allowing auto-promote.
